sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface expression confirmed by antibody binding (FLAG detected on cell surface in Expi293F cells). GPR20 G-protein signaling function NOT MEASURED in this study.
sites.rationale: GPR20 has no native signal peptide; its N-terminus (residues 1–54) is entirely extracellular per the topology landmarks, with TM1 beginning at residue 55 (54 residues of clearance). The PRESTO-Tango-derived construct prepends an HA signal sequence followed by FLAG before the native M1, so after signal cleavage the FLAG tag sits at insert_after_residue=0 (before M1). This is the sole extracellular terminus of this GPCR, making the position topology-derived. Computed: residue_after = seq[0] = 'M', distance to TM1 = 54 aa, well above the 3-residue minimum. Full-length GPR20 expressed in Expi293F cells as part of a 215-GPCR library (PMC10156119). Construct architecture: [HA signal sequence MKTIIALSYIFCLVFA (cleaved)] – [FLAG DYKDDDDA] – [native GPR20 from M1]. The HA signal is cleaved post-translationally, leaving FLAG at the extracellular N-terminus. Used for antibody selectivity profiling; surface expression confirmed by antibody binding assay.

sources.claim: All GPCRs except CALCRL and FZD4, FZD5, FZD6, and FZD10 relied on the codon-optimized PRESTO-Tango library of signal sequence-FLAG-GPCRs as a starting point to generate 215 FLAG-GPCR-1D4 constructs, with the FLAG tag (DYKDDDDA) following the HA signal sequence MKTIIALSYIFCLVFA.

literature_notes: L1 and L2 both describe the same dual-tagged GPR20 construct from PMC10156119 (the 215-GPCR antibody-selectivity library). L2 is the more informative clip (names the exact FLAG sequence and HA signal architecture) and is used as the primary supporting clip. L1 corroborates. The C-terminal 1D4 tag from the same construct is intracellular (topology landmarks place residues 301–358 in the cytoplasm) and is recorded in other_positions. No ledger evidence supports any internal extracellular loop (ECL1 112–123, ECL2 189–196, ECL3 267–276) tag insertion for GPR20; those sites are not proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: The C-terminal 1D4 tag in the FLAG-GPR20-1D4 construct (PMC10156119) is appended after residue 358, which lies within the intracellular C-terminal domain (topology landmarks: INTRACELLULAR 301–358); this is a cytoplasmic tag, not a surface epitope site.
